Name: Tortilla Furniture
Author: GhostPepperIceCream
Description:
Have you ever wanted to decorate your home with tortillas? Well NOW YOU CAN! This mod adds:
- tortillas to stick on the walls and floors
- tortilla chair
- tortilla bench
- tortilla table
- tortilla end table
- tortilla fireplace
- tortilla window
- tortilla lamp
- tortilla rug
- 3 tortilla beds (single, double, and child)
- 2 tortilla-scaped fish tanks

Just buy the furniture catalogue from Robin's shop!

Compatibility
- Centers the furniture if you have Recentered Tortillas installed.

Known Issues
- The fireplace doesn't light up in the right spot. To be honest I don't care enough to fix it
